description: Find investors that match a startup's profile. Filter by sector_focus (e.g. 'Artificial Intelligence' for AI investors), stage_focus (Seed / Series A / etc.), geo_focus, cheque_min / cheque_max (matches investors whose cheque-size window overlaps the founder's raise), active_since (investors whose latest investment is on or after this date, to surface who has deployed capital recently), min_recent_rounds_90d (activity threshold), and actively_investing. Sort whitelist: total_score, last_investment_date, recent_rounds_90d, recent_lead_rounds_90d, total_funds_raised, min_cheque_size, max_cheque_size, last_mentioned_at, created_at. For example sort='last_investment_date.desc' surfaces the most recently active funds first. Page with offset. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

active_since.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Returns investors whose latest investment is on or after this date.

actively_investing.description: Only true filters; false applies no filter.

cheque_max.description: Founder's maximum target raise: matches investors whose min_cheque_size is at most this amount

cheque_min.description: Founder's minimum target raise: matches investors whose max_cheque_size is at least this amount

geo_focus.description: Geographic region the investor targets (e.g. "US", "Europe", "Israel"). Comma-separated values must all be present.

min_recent_rounds_90d.description: Minimum number of rounds in the last 90 days. Use 1+ to drop dormant funds.

offset.description: Skip this many results, for paging.

sector_focus.description: Sector the investor focuses on (e.g. 'Artificial Intelligence', 'Biotech', 'Fintech'). Comma-separated values must all be present.

sort.description: Sort order: '<column>.<asc|desc>' from the whitelist above. Default total_score.desc. An unknown column falls back to the default.

stage_focus.description: Funding stage (e.g. 'Seed', 'Series A'). Comma-separated values must all be present.

type.description: Exact, case-sensitive match on the stored investor type, for example VC, Angel, Accelerator, Corporate VC, Family Office, PE.

name: search_investors
title: Search investors
